reason: B offers the more novel and decisive test by extending edge-dislocation-controlled strengthening from related refractory HEAs to WTaTiVZr and directly measuring dislocation character alongside creep and fracture behavior; A largely restates the already reported WTaTiVZr-versus-W indentation-creep result. B should additionally match grain size and phase state, and its proposed link between edge dislocations and toughness remains an uncertain but falsifiable extrapolation.
